findings: SPD Policy 427 was published July 28, 2026 and governs both mobile and stationary ALPR use.

Policy 427 sets a 30-day baseline retention period; felony-investigation data may be preserved for an additional three months, with longer preservation when evidentiary/discovery/legal obligations apply.
Policy 427 requires logged access and a call type, justification, and DR number for queries, plus quarterly Compliance audits.

Policy 427 allows controlled external law-enforcement/prosecutorial sharing by written request and approval, prohibits vendor sharing, and prohibits ICE/DHS immigration-enforcement sharing absent judicial or court order.
Central Current reported SPD confirmed 14 of 26 new stationary Axon readers were installed and activated at 7:00 a.m. July 27, 2026; 12 remained awaiting installation.

The public Axon transparency portal existed when the policy/activation state was reported, but policy publication and portal availability do not establish that all stated technical controls are enforced.
